build_ddpmtloss_wrapper: build a DDPMTLoss wrapper with mean reduction and a custom coefficient for DDP training
create_mseloss_registered: create a registered MSELoss module that computes element-wise squared error with no reduction
create_maebloss_registered: create a registered MAELoss module that computes element-wise L1 loss with no reduction
build_peratommaeloss: build a PerAtomMAELoss module that divides scalar predictions and targets by atom count before computing L1 loss
create_l2normloss: create a L2NormLoss module that computes the L2 vector norm of prediction minus target differences
